bio: This imposing castle estate provides a truly unique setting for dining. Before taking a seat in the stately Wappensaal in the Schlosshotel at Burg Schlitz, take a leisurely stroll along the Goetheweg. Experience the historical ambiance of this restaurant as you savour a four- to six-course menu of ambitious classic cuisine beneath an impressive high ceiling. The charming and experienced staff will be happy to help you choose the perfect accompaniment to your meal from the well-curated wine list....
